messages:
arjun: Heads-up — I noticed the runtime onboarding guide references s3://redwood-models/old-path and that URL is returning 403 in staging. Anyone owns the onboarding/runbook files?

maria: ugh thanks for the catch. which markdown is that in?

arjun: docs/runtime/onboarding.md under the ‘fetch models’ snippet. repro: `curl -I https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-models/old-path/model.bin` -> 403.

docs-bot: link-checker: detected 403 for s3://redwood-models/old-path in docs/runtime/onboarding.md (scan id 2718281828-1)

nate: I think I moved some assets when doing the i18n doc pass last month — @maria were you the last owner on that file?

maria: I touched it but not the assets. I can take this if it's just rehost to the canonical CDN path. Will open a tiny PR to swap the path and add the shortlink. ETA ~30m.

sophi: nice — ping me on the PR for a quick CR. Also +1 on using a shortlink or cdn URL so we don't hit raw s3 paths again. :+1:

arjun: if it helps, quick sed to replace locally: `sed -i 's|s3://redwood-models/old-path|https://cdn.redwood.ai/models/latest/|g' docs/runtime/*.md`

maria: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1287 — replaces s3 path with cdn URL + adds a note about asset ownership. tagging @sophi for review.

sophi: :eyes: I'll review in ~15 and kick CI.

docs-bot: CI: link-scan passed on branch fix/s3-rehost (job 9284)

maria: merged and deployed to staging. closing the alert :tada:

arjun: amazing, thanks everyone — saved an onboarding user from a 403 :relieved:

nate: nice follow-through, thanks @maria and @sophi!
